note: Book reading of every needs-reading flag in docs/audit/POSITION-AUDIT.md. One entry per (rule, aspect, atoms). aspect 'position' settles wider/narrower/mismatch flags, 'carrier' settles hoa_unbound flags. decision: promote = the book's seat (relation) or carrier becomes a default ('book') requirement; drop = the flag was a misreading, the requirement is the condition's seat; keep_condition = the default stays the condition; a relation that lies inside the condition's seats is kept as the strict-mode ('book?') reading, any other relation only records the book's seat for an upstream pack fix. Pages are printed page numbers (KL/TH/TT = PDF page; NL = HELEN footer page). Quotes are verbatim from the page image (TH lines checked on the image, not the text layer).
